svg.aria-label: The low three bits of the C64's 6510 port at $01 decide whether BASIC, the KERNAL, the I/O chips or the character ROM appear over RAM at $A000, $D000 and $E000.
svg.title: The low three bits of the C64's 6510 port at $01 decide whether BASIC, the KERNAL, the I/O chips or the character ROM appear over RAM at $A000, $D000 and $E000.
svg.text: THE C64 $01 PORT PICKS THE ROMS
The low three bits of $01 (LORAM, HIRAM, CHAREN) switch ROM and I/O over RAM. The map shows a C64 with no cartridge.

g.text: only I/O left: common in games

svg.text: The I/O area holds the VIC-II at $D000, the SID at
CIA 2 picks the VIC-II's 16 KB bank.
Record $01 and the cartridge lines for every
code region you load into Ghidra.
